name: user_requests_employment_letter_with_long_department_name
goal: User with a long department name requests an employment letter.
constraints: Employee details must be present. Department name is unusually long.

testdata.department: International Business Development and Strategic Partnerships

phases.description: Bot displays employee details and options, including long department name.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays department name in full without truncation.
Bot proceeds to trigger mail workflow silently.

phases.description: Bot triggers mail and confirms success.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays the exact confirmation message for employment letter request.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
